title: Gas/aqueous electronic descriptors of a Cs/PEG-SrO model
difficulty_reasons: The object and observables are fixed, while the Agent must independently choose and validate the computational route and formulate an evidence-based phase interpretation without an author-route hint.

paper.title: Investigating the catalytic and antimicrobial properties of ternary cesium/polyethylene glycol-SrO supported by molecular docking and DFT analysis

data.description: Canonical XYZ geometry and system boundary for the neutral-singlet Cs/PEG-SrO cluster.

required_deliverables.description: Structured phase descriptors, validation, comparison, proposed interpretation, and conclusion.
Reproducible methods, identity/state/convergence checks, and limitations.
